evidence.quote: Once the trial balance is final, each entity submits its reconciliations into the consolidation system. We collect data from every ledger and load it centrally before we run eliminations.
evidence.note: Describes entity data collection into central consolidation system prior to running eliminations.

evidence.quote: The consolidation tool runs the intercompany eliminations automatically based on matched IC accounts. It's a fairly mature, machine-driven step. Topside entries are still booked manually by corporate, though.
evidence.note: IC eliminations are automated; topside entries remain manual at corporate level.

evidence.quote: Consolidation is fully centralized at corporate. Regions feed data in, but the actual consolidation and corporate review happen in one central team.

candidate_findings.observation: Topside entries are still booked manually by corporate even though IC eliminations are fully automated, creating an inconsistency in automation maturity within the consolidation step.
candidate_findings.recommended_action: Assess whether topside entry types and volumes are candidates for systemization within the consolidation tool.
